children: Our Bureau Bengaluru: Mid-size IT services firm Coforge reported a 56.5% year-on-year increase in net profit to 588.1 crore for the second quarter of the fiscal year 2027, aided by a full-quarter contribution from its acquisition of engineering services firm Encora for $2.35 billion.

Sequentially, net profit rose 13.4%. Revenue for the September quarter increased 53.6% year-on-year and 11.6% sequentially to 6,170.8 crore. In dollar terms, revenue stood at $652.2 million, up 10.1% from the preceding quarter on constant currency terms. Contribution from the Encora acquisition was a major reason for the revenue growth this quarter along with large deals. "The demand slowdown that we are talking about is largely on account of the fact that the procurement-driven RFPs have slowed down.

The intensity of the ask around delivering AI-led transformation for enterprises is only getting stronger," chief executive officer Sudhir Singh said in the post-earnings analyst call. and close deals without getting into fistcuffs with other providers around pricing," he added. The second quarter was the first to fully consolidate Encora, since its acquisition in December 2025.

Singh said its margin expansion was ahead of plan and revenue growth should mirror Coforge's from Q3, with the largest deal in Coforge's pipeline involving an Encora client. Encora contributed about $147-$148 million in revenue on a constant-currency basis during the quarter, broadly flat against the preceding quarter's comparable full-quarter revenue, chief financial officer Saurabh Goyal said. Deal wins by total contract value stood at $1.04 billion, compared with $691 million in the preceding quarter and $514 million a year earlier. title: Coforge Q2 Net Profit Jumps 56.5% to 588 cr on Encora Deal
